name: RESpecBench
description: RESpecBench is a multi-domain benchmark that measures LLMs' ability to generate precise, semantically equivalent formal specifications from informal natural language descriptions. It spans five domains including Grade-School Math, SQL, First-Order Logic, regular expressions, and Rocq Prover tasks, and uses a sound automated verifier for rigorous evaluation.
reputation: A recent research benchmark with a sound automated verifier, but still early-stage and not yet broadly adopted as a standard benchmark.
notes: Includes a sound and automated verifier; evaluates semantic equivalence rather than just syntax correctness.
